events.details: Dialup, ADSL, hosting; community/sport-club focus ('Community Net'). Birth year inferred (low confidence) — earliest Wayback capture is 3 Feb 2006 with no launch date shown.

Only functioning ISP capture is Feb 2006; site broken (HTTP 500) by Feb 2007; homepage was a 302 redirect to a default IIS/ASP page 2008–2012; domain repurposed as 'In2Recipes' WordPress site by 2013.
